title: ACF CPT / Taxonomy permalink rewrite
description: Permalink rewrite configuration for ACF CPT and Taxonomy JSON. The boolean flags (with_front, feeds, pages, rewrite_hierarchical) accept BOTH encodings: ACF Pro writes a real JSON boolean when the value comes from its own defaults (acf_prepare_internal_post_type_for_export via class-acf-post-type.php), and the string "0"/"1" when it comes from the Admin Sync form. Its consumer casts with (bool), so both round-trip; pinning either one alone rejects legitimate ACF output.

permalink_rewrite.description: Rewrite strategy. no_permalink = no rewrite; post_type_key / taxonomy_key = use the post-type / taxonomy key as the slug (WP default); custom_permalink = use the `slug` field below. ACF uses post_type_key for CPTs and taxonomy_key for taxonomies.

slug.description: The URL prefix when permalink_rewrite is custom_permalink. ACF appends /%postname%/ automatically — do not include it here.

with_front.description: Boolean, in either encoding. ACF Pro writes a real boolean when the value comes from its own defaults (class-acf-post-type.php) and the string "0"/"1" when it comes from the admin form; its consumer casts with (bool), so both are valid input.

feeds.description: Boolean, in either encoding — see with_front.

pages.description: Boolean, in either encoding — see with_front.

rewrite_hierarchical.description: Boolean, in either encoding — taxonomy rewrite option (ACF taxonomy JSON).
